name: Senda Costera, Tierra del Fuego National Park
why: The Beagle Channel shore through beech forest: shell middens, cormorants and quiet coves.
book: Park entry ticket at the gate. The park buses drop you at Bahía Ensenada and pick you up at Lago Acigami.
water: None: carry a bottle. Café at Lago Acigami at the end.
dangers: Roots and short ups and downs; muddy after rain.

points.name: Bahía Ensenada Zaratiegui
points.note: The Ensenada Zaratiegui car park, by the pier and the 'end of the world' post office.

points.name: Beagle Channel coves on the Senda Costera
points.note: Shell middens of the Yámana people and cormorants on the rocks.

points.name: Lago Acigami (Lago Roca), Alakush visitor centre
points.note: The trail ends near the Alakush visitor centre: café, museum and the bus back.
